summary: Nature of 1985 deed: gift vs will; immediate transfer in praesenti vs testamentary disposition; possession not mandatory for gift acceptance; registration as acceptance; revocability under s.126 Transfer of Property Act; mutation does not confer title; concurrent findings reversal by High Court; deed construed as gift with limited reservations; settlor's right to revoke challenged; pre-emption and inheritance claims; validity of cancellation and sale deeds; burden of proof in gift disputes.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding gift deed and setting aside cancellation/sale deeds upheld; decree in favour of respondent for declaration of title based on 1985 gift deed restored.
